//: Example .claude/orchestrator.json — copy to <project-root>/.claude/orchestrator.json and trim to taste. JSON has no comments; the // keys below are illustrative and should be deleted in a real manifest. Any role may be null or omitted to disable the phases that depend on it.
//pm: Names the PM agent. Backend config lives in .claude/pm.json, NOT here.
//vault: Names the vault agent. Presence enables vault search + findings scan.
//reviewers: Presence-only. Order ignored — the orchestrator decides ordering.
//security: Conditional security pass; runs only on sensitive changes.
